sources.quote: A temporary deviation may cover at most 2000 pieces and at most 6 weeks.

findings.why: The proposed deviation covers 3,500 pieces over 10 weeks. That is over both limits in PRC-DEV-007 rev 2, which is effective and controlled. The 100% hole inspection meets the inspection condition but does not raise the limits. The only allowed responses are to expedite the approved source or to request a deviation within 2000 pieces and 6 weeks.

sources.quote: A temporary deviation is requested through the supplier portal and needs approval before shipment.

findings.why: BR-220 ships to STL, and the STL customer requirement in force says a temporary deviation needs approval before shipment. No approval is in the documents. The deviation must be requested through the STL supplier portal and approved before any piece ships.
